title: DATESBETWEEN over a calendar with two dates after its last date returns every date
query: EVALUATE CALCULATETABLE ( ROW ( "first", MINX ( DATESBETWEEN ( Gregorian, DATE ( 2015, 1, 1 ), DATE ( 2015, 12, 31 ) ), 'Date'[Date] ), "last", MAXX ( DATESBETWEEN ( Gregorian, DATE ( 2015, 1, 1 ), DATE ( 2015, 12, 31 ) ), 'Date'[Date] ), "days", COUNTROWS ( DATESBETWEEN ( Gregorian, DATE ( 2015, 1, 1 ), DATE ( 2015, 12, 31 ) ) ) ), ALL ( 'Date' ) )

source.quote: Thus, with a calendar, two dates after the last date return all the dates.

derivation: Neither date is in Date, so both are read as BLANK: the first date to the last, 42 days.
